dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're adventurers that specialize in solving particular problems.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: Oh, well that's good to hear. If that's the case, there's a burden off my chest.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: You should have already seen that fool child Nasejuna, yes? The fact that you're standing here means that his plot failed.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: Before, when Nasejuna asked me about the Kory Drums, I knew he was up to no good.

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: Hence, I deliberately hid the fact that I had one of the Kory Drums and entrusted it to an acquaintance I have in the Akademiya...

dialogues.speaker: Aryadeva
dialogues.text: The glory days of the Order of Skeptics are bygone legends by now. Rather than harboring their dangerous delusions, its better to see their desires manifest in light novels instead.
